a high-fidelity 3D game CG masterpiece in the style of a polished anime illustration, featuring a hyper-aesthetic young teenage girl with an idoll-like pure-yet-alluring charisma, possessing a cold porcelain white skin tone and a petite, delicate frame. She sports a chic vintage side-swept bang hairstyle, half-tied into a fluffy and relaxed messy ponytail with loose strands framing her face. She is wearing a cozy winter off-the-shoulder cream cable-knit sweater that elegantly exposes her collarbones and shoulders, paired with dark plaid mini-skirt and sheer black tights. She is posing playfully, making a cute peace sign with her fingers while gazing directly at the camera with a sweet, confident smile. The setting is a cozy, slightly messy, and youthful bedroom filled with personal items, bottles, books, and photos on the walls, creating a lived-in, intimate atmosphere with a distinct millennium Y2K aesthetic. The lighting is soft and warm, casting a nostalgic glow on her skin. The image quality is exceptionally high, with crisp details, vibrant colors, and professional rendering, utilizing octane render, ray tracing, subsurface scattering for skin texture, and a clean composition that centers the subject. masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality
